events.text: Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Club Brugge 0, Aston Villa 1. John McGinn (Aston Villa) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Pau Torres.
Goal! Club Brugge 1, Aston Villa 1. Hugo Vetlesen (Club Brugge) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jan Virgili.
Goal! Club Brugge 1, Aston Villa 2. Emiliano Buendía (Aston Villa) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by João Gomes.
Goal! Club Brugge 1, Aston Villa 3. Nicolas Jackson (Aston Villa) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Pau Torres following a fast break.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Hugo Siquet replaces Kyriani Sabbe.
